description: This Java source file configures web MVC settings, specifically Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) policies, for a Spring Boot application to enable permissive cross-origin requests during development.

classes.name: WebConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that defines a WebMvcConfigurer bean to setup CORS mappings.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Defines a bean that returns a WebMvcConfigurer with CORS configuration allowing all origins and common HTTP methods for specified API path patterns.
